assessmentScope: New noise seeds on the same development physical cases; not new physical OOD or a failure-probability guarantee.

design.model: Nominal linear plant plus existing stationary KF mean, zero-mean measurement noise. The force is used to design a disturbance response, not supplied to the runtime controller/filter.

acceptance: Profile is locked before assessment; preserve every original failure and unchanged 300-step/tail50/15mm/0.025rad protocol. A boundary failure is not a successful recovery. No retuning after opening the assessment seeds.
